subject: Error when running micro_ncep 'subscript out of bounds'

messages.author: d46a200ec8517da4
messages.subject: Error when running micro_ncep 'subscript out of bounds'
parts:
Hi

I'm new to using NicheMapR but recently I've run into error anytime I try to use micro_ncep(). I keep getting the error "Error in strsplit(grep("add_offset", x = readLines(scale.offset.missingvals.temp),  :  subscript out of bounds"


An example of the code I am running is:
micro <- micro_ncep(loc = c(-89.49, 43.07), dstart = "01/01/2000", dfinish = "31/12/2000")

and the output is:
downloading DEM via package elevatr 
Downloading DEMs [===========================] 100% eta:  0s
Merging DEMs
Reprojecting DEM to original projection
Note: Elevation units are in meters.
Note: The coordinate reference system is:
 +init=epsg:3395 +proj=merc +lon_0=0 +k=1 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs +ellps=WGS84 +towgs84=0,0,0
downloading weather data with package RNCEP via package microclima 
trying URL 'http://www.esrl.noaa.gov/psd/thredds/dodsC/Datasets/ncep.reanalysis2/gaussian_grid/air.2m.gauss.1999.nc.das'
Content length 162 bytes
downloaded 2625 bytes

Error in strsplit(grep("add_offset", x = readLines(scale.offset.missingvals.temp),  : 
  subscript out of bounds

I'm not sure why it keeps giving me this error. I've tried reloading the NicheMapR thinking that that may help, but the error persists.

Thanks,
Evan

messages.author: 15914ff4afa133aa
messages.subject: Re: Error when running micro_ncep 'subscript out of bounds'
parts:
Seems to be a recent error. I tried to run a script that had no issues a few weeks ago, but is now throwing the same error. After a little digging, it looks like the root issue is in the RNCEP package with the NCEP.gather.XXXX/NCEP.interp.XXXX functions when using reanlysis2 (nicheMapR uses this package to download all the data). Reinstalling this package does not appear to help. I have reached out to the creator of this package to see if he has any suggestions

-Andrew

messages.author: 15914ff4afa133aa
messages.subject: Re: Error when running micro_ncep 'subscript out of bounds'
parts:
Here's the response from RNCEP creator:

"Thanks for letting me know! It appears they have removed meta data fields for scale and offset from the reanalysis2 data. This is causing the process to fail as it expects to see these fields in reanalysis2. I’ll get an update pushed out soon. In the meantime, the reanalysis1 dataset appears to still be working."
